headline: Heineken Warns GLP-1 Weight-Loss Drugs Could Curb British Pub Beer Sales
summary: Heineken warned British hospitality operators that the surging popularity of GLP-1 weight-loss medications like Wegovy and Ozempic could depress consumer alcohol appetite and reduce pub beer and cider sales.
why: Heineken is the world's second-largest brewer. Behavioral shifts induced by widespread adoption of appetite-suppressing pharmaceuticals present structural demand considerations for global beverage and snack producers.

impacts.name: Heineken NV
impacts.why: Potential reduction in alcoholic beverage consumption threatens long-term on-premise volume growth.

impacts.name: Hospitality
impacts.why: Lower alcohol sales per customer could compress beverage profit margins across UK bars and pub estates.
